description: FINRA short-interest trend for one ticker: the biweekly settlement-date short-percent series, OLDEST-FIRST. Returns {summary, ticker, count, as_of, trend}; each point is EXACTLY {date (settlement date), shortPct (a PERCENTAGE number)} -- no share counts and no days-to-cover. `points` default 6, max 26 (about one year). A fortnightly SNAPSHOT with a reporting lag, not a live short-float figure; `as_of` is the settlement date, not today. Honest-empty for a ticker FINRA does not publish; an unreachable store is REFUSED (DATA_UNAVAILABLE). Source: FINRA (public); FREE.
name: ol_short_interest_trend
title: Short Interest Trend
